```{r}
#Uji cronbach alpha

# Install packagenya kalo belum ada
if (!require(psych)) install.packages("psych", dependencies = TRUE)

# Load packagenya
library(psych)

data <- read_csv("sample_cinema_121.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) 

# Ambil hanya kolom item 1-10, 12, dan 13 (kategorikal & skala likert)
# Subset data
item_data <- data[, c(7:16, 18, 19)]

# Konversi ke numerik
item_data[] <- lapply(item_data, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))

# Ganti nama kolomnya jadi Q1 sampai Q13
colnames(item_data) <- paste0("Q", 1:12)

# Q1 = 1. I am satisfied with the current cinema ticket price
# Q2 = 2. I believe the current pricing for a cinema ticket is reasonable and affordable than other entertainment options (e.g., streaming services, concert, etc.)
# Q3 = 3. I am willing to pay for flexible ticket pricing (cheaper prices on weekdays)
# Q4 = 4. I have visited the cinema more than once in the past 3 months
# Q5 = 5. I will visit the cinema more frequently if the ticket prices are reduced by 20%
# Q6 = 6. I prefer regular cinema tickets compared to premium/special event tickets
# Q7 = 7. I am willing to pay a higher price for a ticket with premium benefits (e.g., luxury seating, exclusive screening)
# Q8 = 8. I visit cinemas in urban areas
# Q9 = 9. I am willing to spend outside of my entertainment budget for a special screening
# Q10 = 10. I allocate some money for my entertainment activities for each month
# Q11 = 12. I prefer going to cinema on the weekdays
# Q12 = 13. I prefer going to cinema on the weekends

# Hapus baris yang mengandung NA/Not Available (kalo ada)
item_data <- na.omit(item_data)

# Hitung nilai Cronbach's Alphanya
result <- psych::alpha(item_data)

# Print nilai Cronbach's Alphanya
cat("Cronbach's Alpha:", round(result$total$raw_alpha, 3), "\n\n")
```

```{r}
#Modus (Uji Statistika Deskriptif)

# Load the necessary library
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

# Load datasetnya
data <- read_csv("sample_cinema_121.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Fungsi untuk menghitung modusnya
get_mode <- function(v) {
  uniqv <- unique(v)
  uniqv[which.max(tabulate(match(v, uniqv)))]
}

# Ambil semua kolom pernyataan 1 sampai 15 (kolom ke-7 sampai ke-21)
question_data <- data[, 7:21]

# Hitung modus untuk setiap kolomnya
modes <- sapply(question_data, get_mode)

# Tampilkan hasilnya
for (i in seq_along(modes)) {
  cat(names(modes)[i], ":", modes[[i]], "\n")
}
```

```{r}
#Uji Chi-Square per pernyataan

# Load library
library(readr)

# Definisi kelompok kolomn berdasarkan kategorinya
ticket_price_cols <- c(
  "1. I am satisfied with the current cinema ticket price",
  "2. I believe the current pricing for a cinema ticket is reasonable and affordable than other entertainment options (e.g., streaming services, concert, etc.)",
  "3. I am willing to pay for flexible ticket pricing (cheaper prices on weekdays)"
)

audience_freq_cols <- c(
  "4. I have visited the cinema more than once in the past 3 months",
  "5. I will visit the cinema more frequently if the ticket prices are reduced by 20%"
)

ticket_type_cols <- c(
  "6. I prefer regular cinema tickets compared to premium/special event tickets",
  "7. I am willing to pay a higher price for a ticket with premium benefits (e.g., luxury seating, exclusive screening)"
)

location_cols <- c(
  "8. I visit cinemas in urban areas",
  "15. I usually watch movies at cinemas in"
)

budget_cols <- c(
  "9. I am willing to spend outside of my entertainment budget for a special screening",
  "10. I allocate some money for my entertainment activities for each month",
  "11. I allocate my budget for entertainment activities"
)

day_cols <- c(
  "12. I prefer going to cinema on the weekdays",
  "13. I prefer going to cinema on the weekends",
  "14. I frequently watch movies in the cinema on any day of the week"
)

# Fungsi buat uji chi-square antar dua variabel
run_chisq_tests <- function(group_x, group_y, data) {
  for (x in group_x) {
    for (y in group_y) {
      # Buat tabel kontingensi
      tbl <- table(data[[x]], data[[y]])
      # Hanya lakukan uji jika tabel valid
      if (all(dim(tbl) > 1)) {
        test <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tbl))
        cat("\nChi-Square Test:", "\n")
        cat("X:", x, "\n")
        cat("Y:", y, "\n")
        cat("p-value:", test$p.value, "\n")
        cat("--------------------------------------------------\n")
      }
    }
  }
}

# Jalanin perbandingan semua pernyataan dari masing-masing variabel dibanding Audience Frequency
cat("=== Ticket Price vs Audience Frequency ===\n")
run_chisq_tests(ticket_price_cols, audience_freq_cols, data)

cat("\n=== Location vs Audience Frequency ===\n")
run_chisq_tests(location_cols, audience_freq_cols, data)

cat("\n=== Ticket Type vs Audience Frequency ===\n")
run_chisq_tests(ticket_type_cols, audience_freq_cols, data)

cat("\n=== Day vs Audience Frequency ===\n")
run_chisq_tests(day_cols, audience_freq_cols, data)

cat("\n=== Budget vs Audience Frequency ===\n")
run_chisq_tests(budget_cols, audience_freq_cols, data)
```

```{r}
#Uji Chi-Square per variabel

# Load library
library(readr)

# Definisi kelompok kolom berdasarkan kategorinya
ticket_price_cols <- c(
  "1. I am satisfied with the current cinema ticket price",
  "2. I believe the current pricing for a cinema ticket is reasonable and affordable than other entertainment options (e.g., streaming services, concert, etc.)",
  "3. I am willing to pay for flexible ticket pricing (cheaper prices on weekdays)"
)

audience_freq_cols <- c(
  "4. I have visited the cinema more than once in the past 3 months",
  "5. I will visit the cinema more frequently if the ticket prices are reduced by 20%"
)

ticket_type_cols <- c(
  "6. I prefer regular cinema tickets compared to premium/special event tickets",
  "7. I am willing to pay a higher price for a ticket with premium benefits (e.g., luxury seating, exclusive screening)"
)

location_cols <- c(
  "8. I visit cinemas in urban areas",
  "15. I usually watch movies at cinemas in"
)

budget_cols <- c(
  "9. I am willing to spend outside of my entertainment budget for a special screening",
  "10. I allocate some money for my entertainment activities for each month",
  "11. I allocate my budget for entertainment activities"
)

day_cols <- c(
  "12. I prefer going to cinema on the weekdays",
  "13. I prefer going to cinema on the weekends",
  "14. I frequently watch movies in the cinema on any day of the week"
)

# Fungsi buat variabel gabungan dari beberapa kolom
combine_columns <- function(data, cols) {
  apply(data[, cols], 1, function(row) paste(row, collapse = "_"))
}

# Gabungin pernyataan-pernyataan per kategorinya
data$ticket_price_combo <- combine_columns(data, ticket_price_cols)
data$audience_freq_combo <- combine_columns(data, audience_freq_cols)
data$ticket_type_combo <- combine_columns(data, ticket_type_cols)
data$location_combo <- combine_columns(data, location_cols)
data$budget_combo <- combine_columns(data, budget_cols)
data$day_combo <- combine_columns(data, day_cols)

# Fungsi buat uji chi square antar dua variabel yang udah di gabung
run_combined_chisq <- function(x, y, x_label, y_label) {
  tbl <- table(x, y)
  if (all(dim(tbl) > 1)) {
    test <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tbl))
    cat("\nChi-Square Test (Combined Variables):", "\n")
    cat("X:", x_label, "\n")
    cat("Y:", y_label, "\n")
    cat("p-value:", test$p.value, "\n")
    cat("--------------------------------------------------\n")
  }
}

# Jalanin perbandingan semua tipe variabel dibanding Audience Frequency
run_combined_chisq(data$ticket_price_combo, data$audience_freq_combo, "Ticket Price", "Audience Frequency")
run_combined_chisq(data$location_combo, data$audience_freq_combo, "Location", "Audience Frequency")
run_combined_chisq(data$ticket_type_combo, data$audience_freq_combo, "Ticket Type", "Audience Frequency")
run_combined_chisq(data$day_combo, data$audience_freq_combo, "Day", "Audience Frequency")
run_combined_chisq(data$budget_combo, data$audience_freq_combo, "Budget", "Audience Frequency")
```

```{r}
# Uji Korelasi Spearman antara Variabel Numerik


# Pilih kolom numerik untuk korelasi (kolom data ke 7-16, 18, 19) ([nya])
numerical_data <- data[, c("satisfaction", "reasonablePricing", "flexiblePricing", "cinemaVisits3months", 
                           "priceReductionVisit", "regularTicketPreference", "premiumTicketWillingness", 
                           "urbanCinemaVisits", "specialScreeningWillingness", "monthlyEntertainmentBudget", 
                           "weekdayPreference", "weekendPreference")]

# Fungsi buat hitung korelasi Spearman antar variabel numerik 
spearman_numerical_correlation_manual <- function(numerical_data, pairs) {
  results <- list()
  
  # Hitung korelasi buat setiap pasangan kolom yang udah didefinisi
  for (pair in pairs) {
    num_col1 <- pair[1]
    num_col2 <- pair[2]
    
    # Hitung korelasi Spearman antara dua variabel numerik
    spearman_result <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(numerical_data[[num_col1]], 
                                                 numerical_data[[num_col2]], 
                                                 method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"))
    
    # Periksa signifikan atau tidak hubungan berdasarkan p-value nya
    significant <- ifelse(spearman_result$p.value < 0.05, "There is significant relationship", "There is no significant relationship")
    
    results[[paste(num_col1, num_col2, sep = "_")]] <- list(
      rho = spearman_result$estimate, 
      p_value = spearman_result$p.value, 
      significant = significant
    )
  }
  
  return(results)
}

# Definisi pasangan kolom berdasarkan variabel

# Grouping berdasarkan variabel "satisfaction"
pairs_satisfaction <- list(
  c("satisfaction", "reasonablePricing"),
  c("satisfaction", "flexiblePricing"),
```

```{r}
# Uji Korelasi Spearman antara Variabel Kategorikal


categorical_data <- data.frame(
  budgetAllocation = rep(c("Less than Rp 100.000", "Rp 100.000-300.000", "Rp 300.000-500.000", "More than Rp 500.000"), length.out = 14),
  cinemaLocation = rep(c("North Jakarta", "East Jakarta", "South Jakarta", "West Jakarta",
                          "Central Jakarta", "Tangerang City", "South Tangerang", "Tangerang Regency"), length.out = 14),
  weeklyCinemaVisits = rep(c("Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday"), length.out = 14)
)


# Konversi variabel kategorikal ke faktor dengan level yang udah ditentukan (ordinal & nominal)

# budgetAllocation: ordinal
categorical_data$budgetAllocation <- factor(categorical_data$budgetAllocation, 
                                            levels = c("Less than Rp 100.000", 
                                                       "Rp 100.000-300.000", 
                                                       "Rp 300.000-500.000", 
                                                       "More than Rp 500.000"), 
                                            ordered = TRUE)
categorical_data$budgetAllocation <- as.numeric(categorical_data$budgetAllocation)


# cinemaLocation: nominal
categorical_data$cinemaLocation <- factor(categorical_data$cinemaLocation, 
                                          levels = c("North Jakarta", "East Jakarta", "South Jakarta", "West Jakarta", 
                                                     "Central Jakarta", "Tangerang City", "South Tangerang", "Tangerang Regency"))
categorical_data$cinemaLocation <- as.numeric(categorical_data$cinemaLocation)


# weeklyCinemaVisits: nominal (days of week)
categorical_data$weeklyCinemaVisits <- factor(categorical_data$weeklyCinemaVisits, 
                                               levels = c("Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday"))
categorical_data$weeklyCinemaVisits <- as.numeric(categorical_data$weeklyCinemaVisits)


# Pastiin categorical_data tetap sebagai data.frame nya
categorical_data <- as.data.frame(categorical_data)

# Filter baris yang lengkap dan nilai finitenya
valid_rows <- complete.cases(categorical_data) &
              is.finite(categorical_data$budgetAllocation) &
              is.finite(categorical_data$cinemaLocation) &
              is.finite(categorical_data$weeklyCinemaVisits)

cleaned_data <- categorical_data[valid_rows, ]

# Fungsi buat hitung korelasi Spearman antar variabel kategorikal 
spearman_categorical_correlation_manual <- function(categorical_data) {
  results <- list()
  
  # Pasangan kolom untuk dihitung korelasinya
  pairs <- list(
    c("budgetAllocation", "weeklyCinemaVisits"),
    c("budgetAllocation", "cinemaLocation"),
    c("weeklyCinemaVisits", "cinemaLocation")
  )
  
  for (pair in pairs) {
    cat_col1 <- pair[1]
    cat_col2 <- pair[2]
    
    clean_col1 <- as.numeric(categorical_data[[cat_col1]])
    clean_col2 <- as.numeric(categorical_data[[cat_col2]])
    
    # Pastikan data valid, hapus NA dan Inf
    valid_index <- !is.na(clean_col1) & !is.na(clean_col2) & is.finite(clean_col1) & is.finite(clean_col2)
    clean_col1 <- clean_col1[valid_index]
    clean_col2 <- clean_col2[valid_index]
    
    if (length(clean_col1) > 1 & length(clean_col2) > 1) {
      spearman_result <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(clean_col1, clean_col2, method = "spearman"))
      significant <- ifelse(spearman_result$p.value < 0.05, 
                            "There is significant relationship", 
                            "There is no significant relationship")
      
      results[[paste(cat_col1, cat_col2, sep = "_")]] <- list(
        rho = spearman_result$estimate,
        p_value = spearman_result$p.value,
        significant = significant
      )
    } else {
      results[[paste(cat_col1, cat_col2, sep = "_")]] <- list(
        rho = NA,
        p_value = NA,
        significant = "Not enough data"
      )
    }
  }
  
  return(results)
}

# Fungsi korelasi (data udah dibersihkan)
categorical_correlation_results <- spearman_categorical_correlation_manual(cleaned_data)

# Display atau print hasil korelasinya
cat("\n\nSpearman correlation results between categorical variables:\n")
for (result_name in names(categorical_correlation_results)) {
  var_names <- strsplit(result_name, "_")[[1]]
  
  cat("\nSpearman correlation between", var_names[1], "and", var_names[2], ":\n")
  cat("rho =", categorical_correlation_results[[result_name]]$rho, "\n")
  cat("p-value =", categorical_correlation_results[[result_name]]$p_value, "\n")
  cat(categorical_correlation_results[[result_name]]$significant, "\n")
}
```
